Update out today to fix a progress-halting issue some players were experiencing.

v1.0.10 Patch Notes

notes.title: v1.0.9 Update Out
notes.notes:
Update out today that adds an ULTRA BLOOD option to game settings. Turn it on to make everything bleed more! Have fun, and don't forget to wear a raincoat! :) -Trevor

v1.0.9 Patch Notes

Features
--"Ultra Blood" option added to game settings

Visuals:
--Did I mention the option for more blood???
--Gibs now emit some blood in normal mode

Bugs:

notes.title: v1.0.8 Update Out
notes.notes:
Patch out today that turns up the wasteland violence! Monster hearts now beat and blood sprays from loosed organ locations, plus a bunch of small fixes and a new Easter egg... Go forth and shred the wastes! Have a bloody good time! :) -Trevor

v1.0.8 Patch Notes

Visuals:
--Monster heart/heart-like organs now beat
--Added blood spray at locations where monster organs fall out
--Monster organs now cast a slight shadow to help their depth stand out a bit more
--Particle effects on ballistic miss now show further from attack location
--Fixed issue with some monster gallery shadows not showing at correct height
--Fixed issue with Splutlet’s gallery shadow
--Small updates to some structure sprites

Bugs:
--Fixed issue with miss ‘X’ not showing in correct location in certain combat galleries

Other:
--Lodged in the muck, an ancient relic has appeared, holding within it the echo of a long-lost cautionary ballad...

notes.title: v1.0.6 Patch Out
notes.notes:
Patch out today that includes Fast Combat option, separate SFX/Music volume, and makes Zar even more fun to use! Go forth and decimate the wastes! -Trevor

v1.0.6 Patch Notes

Features:
--Fast Combat option added. Decreases many time delays in combat for those that like faster pace of play.
--SFX and Music volume controls now separated
--Game Options now have their own overlay
--NPCs now have a short period where player cannot talk to them after conversation ends. This should help prevent player from unintentionally running into NPC after just talking with them.

Weapons:
--Zar crosshair and line markers updated to increase readability and help keep track of end of line
--If Zar attack misses, pattern now remains on screen so you don’t have to draw it again - but you never miss, right??? :)

Passives:
--Updated Misery Eater and Suture Spider description to improve clarity

Text:
--Increased size of quest guidance text in lower left of in-game menu

Bugs:
--Fixed issue where using adrenaline to gain action did not reset “Low on TIme” cursor status for weapons that cost 2 actions to use
--Fixed bad transfer control in Act 4 approach map - put player outside boundaries

notes.title: v1.0.5 Patch Out
notes.notes:
v1.0.5 Patch Notes

Features:
--Pressing Shift while buying ammo and some utility items will now buy the maximum amount the player can afford
--Jack now has a visibility highlight when moving behind foreground walls in the map - the star of the show always has to be visible! :)

Monsters:
--Small balances to final boss fight

Visuals:
--Minor change to up/down menu arrow
--Minor cosmetic updates to some weapon crosshairs

Text:
--Added tool tip text for player adrenaline gauge and stat bonus tracker
--Added text to bonus food item descriptions to make it clearer their effect is permanent
--Added text to knife holster description and store upgrade descriptions to make it clearer monster meat yield bonus is passive
--Mutant Gauntlet store description now says “Fist Pattern” instead of “Punch Pattern”
--Mutant Gauntlet holster description now refers to “left/right fist” pattern instead of “mirror pattern” to increase clarity
--Tool tip text for some dashboard elements should now show with buffer from screen edge
--Added % values to Ballistic Shield item holster description

Passives:
--Ballistic Shield Dodge debuff decreased from 10% to 5%

Bugs:
--Fixed issue where Quake Cannon weapon would disappear from store. Weapon should now show up for players who experienced bug in previous build.
--Fixed issue where Act 4 miniboss could drop key in inaccessible location
--When Auto Holster or Auto Pouch equipped, tool tip text when hovering over affected weapon/item holster now correctly reads “Free Swap” instead of “-1 TU”
--Fixed issue where monster accessory item in final boss battle was incorrectly affecting player stat modifiers

notes.title: OUTTA GAS Has Left Early Access - Full Release Now Available!!!
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce that OUTTA GAS has left Early Access and is now fully released on Steam! All content now available!

With 30+ hours of content spread across four distinct acts, over 70 monsters, more than 25 weapons, heaps of upgrades and passive items, and much more, OUTTA GAS will be one hell of a ride you'll never forget! Nope, nothing's quite like it...

I'd like to thank everyone that helped make Early Access such an enjoyable and productive time. Your time and effort has made OUTTA GAS an even greater experience and is much appreciated! Thank you!

And welcome to all you new wasteland-hardened badasses joining us! Please join us on the Discord server community and share in this adventure. I'd love to meet you and hear what you think of OUTTA GAS!

Other than Discord, the Steam community discussion board is open for you to post any thoughts you have on the game or about any issues you run into. I'm here to help and will look into these ASAP!

Enjoy!

--Trevor

notes.notes:
Small patch out today to help new players better understand controls and gameplay systems. -Trevor

---

Tutorial Hints:
--Added WASD UI hint in first map to help players learn movement, not expect mouse to move them
--Improved UI explanation overlay that shows during second battle, specifically to better explain monster stat gauges (upper right) and how they're tied to monster stats

notes.title: Release Trailer! OUTTA GAS Full Release Coming March 26th!
Early Access v0.44 Patch
notes.notes:
Small patch out today. Fixed issue with mouse disappearing when controller plugged in and added UI hints to help players better understand combat gallery UI. -Trevor

---

Early Access v0.44 Patch

Bug Fixes:
--Mouse no longer disappears from screen when controller plugged in

Tutorial Hints:
--Added UI hints to help players learn how to use consumables (e.g., health injectors)
--Added UI hints to help players find where grenades are kept in inventory
--Adjusted dashboard overlay to account for grenade UI hint

Other:
--Changed dialog option to advance conversation from "Continue" to "(Click anywhere)". Noticed some players were clicking precisely on "Continue" to advance dialog, which is actually not necessary, unless you are training your mouse precision skills.
